notes: Path shortcuts: write a folder down once on the Games page - %GAMES% for D:\Games - and use it in every game's program, working folder, extras and save folders. One row to change when the games move to a different disk, instead of every game. Windows' own variables go on working as before, and a real Windows variable of the same name still wins, so a machine laid out differently can override the shop. Launch arguments now understand variables too, and every path box shows what it comes to on this computer.
